verdict.rationale: Basecamp's pricing page lists a first-party feature to track hours or time spent working on projects, which covers the project half of the story. That evidence is a single line, and nothing shows time being logged against individual to-dos or tasks. missing for 10: documented time logging against individual tasks/to-dos, detailed docs on how time entries are recorded, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects

citations.quote: Track hours/time spent working on projects.
